note: The floor is measured, not chosen. In-corpus questions score 0.71-0.79 and out-of-corpus 0.45-0.61; the floor sits in the gap. The adrenaline question is why an earlier 0.55 was wrong: IPHS says nothing about dosing, but it is a clinical document, so a clinical question scores well above an unrelated one. Measures retrieval behaviour only. IPHS states what a facility should provide, not what to do for a patient, and no clinical claim follows from these numbers.
